purpose: one bounded post-v2 revision; approximately rate/distortion-matched codec comparison and natural joint-arm residual localization
tail_padding: repeat last action; valid length recorded; padded steps never executed
label_equality: all sampled official success/on/static/grasp labels exact
force_boundary: last physics substep sampled at 20 Hz; not integrated force or peak
cost_reference: symmetric approximately matched rate and arm MSE; no hard-cap efficiency claim
selection: no fitting or grid selection; fixed 6-bit/3-knot from Stage 7 audit, outside v2 hard cap
mechanism: copy unchanged 5x7 arm residual from original event window to matched noncontact window; gripper and all other actions original
rate_definition: actual binary episode packet bytes plus one 128-byte normalization record per method, divided by padded chunks; pretrained model assets reported separately
outcome_rule: official final success at the original planner-completion horizon; identical lengths, no settling or first-success stopping
unavailable_variants: retain unavailable/invalid counts and report observed success only on common verified originals, never impute physical failure
calibration_mode: reuse sealed v2 action statistics; no new calibration episodes or fitting
pre_intervention_gate: at least 16 replay-valid originals; all three codecs available on every valid original; joint/linear cohort rate and MSE overlap; at least 8 eligible pairs for each event, without outcome filtering
primary_estimand: for each event, paired final-success difference between identical natural joint-arm residual at event versus matched noncontact
codec_estimand: paired final-success difference of fixed joint FAST and linear control on the whole supported cohort; approximately matched, not equal rate or exact error matching
automatic_action_after_null: end current contact-sensitive method route; no grid/amplitude/task/seed expansion
